services.name: Business Permit (New Application)
requirements: Lease Contract or Land Title (proof of business address)
Sanitary Permit from Municipal Health Office
services.fees: Varies based on business type, capitalization, and gross sales
steps: Secure Barangay Clearance from your barangay
Get Zoning Clearance from the Municipal Planning Office
Obtain Sanitary Permit from the Municipal Health Office
Get Fire Safety Inspection Certificate from BFP
Submit all requirements to the BPLO
Pay the assessed fees at the Municipal Treasurer's Office

services.name: Business Permit (Renewal)
services.fees: Based on declared gross sales/receipts from previous year
steps: Renew Fire Safety and Sanitary Permits
Pay fees at Municipal Treasurer's Office
services.deadline: January 20 of each year (late renewals subject to surcharge)

services.name: Barangay Clearance
services.processing_time: Same day (if Barangay Captain is available)
steps: Present your valid ID and Cedula

services.name: Birth Certificate (Local Civil Registry)
requirements: Valid ID of the requesting party
Authorization letter (if not the document owner)

services.name: Marriage Certificate (Local Civil Registry)
requirements: Authorization letter (if not one of the parties)

services.name: Death Certificate (Local Civil Registry)
requirements: Proof of relationship to the deceased

services.name: Real Property Tax (RPT) Payment
requirements: Tax Declaration Number or Owner's Name
services.fees: Based on assessed value of property (basic rate + SEF)
services.notes: Quarterly payments accepted. Deadline: January 31 (annual), or quarterly (Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30, Dec 31). Early payment discount available.

services.name: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
requirements: For individuals: declaration of gross income
For corporations: declaration of gross receipts
services.fees: Basic tax PHP 5.00 + additional tax based on income/property

services.name: Building Permit
requirements: Bill of materials and cost estimate
Land title or authorization from lot owner
services.fees: Based on total project cost and floor area

office_hours.municipal_hall: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (no noon break)
office_hours.sanggunian_sessions: Every Monday, 9:00 AM at the SB Session Hall
office_hours.note: Offices may be closed during national holidays and local fiestas

esangguni_platform.about: eSANGGUNI is the AI-powered digital governance platform of the Sangguniang Bayan ng Pitogo, designed to improve legislative efficiency and citizen access to local government services.

ella.name: E.L.L.A. (Executive & Legislative Legal Assistant)
ella.description: AI legal research tool for Sanggunian members. Provides instant access to R.A. 7160 (Local Government Code), its IRR, and all 349 Pitogo municipal ordinances with citation-backed answers.

obra.name: O.B.R.A. (Ordinance Builder & Review Assistant)
obra.description: AI-powered ordinance drafting and compliance review tool. Generates properly structured municipal ordinances and checks drafts for legal compliance with R.A. 7160.
obra.audience: Sangguniang Bayan members and legislative staff

yala.name: Y.A.L.A. (Your AI Legislative Assistant)
yala.description: Citizen-facing AI chatbot providing information about Pitogo municipal services, requirements, fees, and local ordinances in simple conversational language.
yala.audience: Citizens of Pitogo and the general public

frequently_asked.question: Where is the Municipal Hall located?
frequently_asked.answer: The Municipal Hall is located at Poblacion, Pitogo, Quezon 4308. It is the center of local government operations.

frequently_asked.question: What are the office hours?
frequently_asked.answer: Municipal Hall offices are open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM with no noon break.

frequently_asked.question: How do I file a complaint?
frequently_asked.answer: You may file a complaint at the Sangguniang Bayan Office or the Mayor's Office during regular office hours. Bring a written complaint letter and valid ID.

frequently_asked.question: When are the Sanggunian sessions?
frequently_asked.answer: Regular sessions of the Sangguniang Bayan are held every Monday at 9:00 AM at the SB Session Hall. Sessions are open to the public.
